stemMarkdown: Find the highest power of $2$ that divides $30!$.
solutionMarkdown: By Legendre's formula, add the floors of $30$ divided by successive powers of $2$: \left\lfloor \dfrac{30}{2} \right\rfloor = 15 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{30}{4} \right\rfloor = 7 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{30}{8} \right\rfloor = 3 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{30}{16} \right\rfloor = 1. The total is $26$.
